claims.text: An HTTPRoute rule's backendRefs may name several Services, each with a weight; each gets requests in proportion to weight / sum of the rule's weights. Weight 0 sends that backend no requests; a backendRef without a weight counts as weight 1.
claims.source_hint: Gateway API docs: HTTPRoute > BackendRefs weight; Traffic splitting guide

A Deployment's rolling update by default allows at most 25% extra Pods (maxSurge, rounded up: one for api's 2 replicas); rolling back (kubectl rollout undo) is itself a rollout that replaces Pods.
claims.source_hint: Kubernetes docs: Deployments > Max Surge; Rolling Back a Deployment; base/api.yaml replicas: 2, no strategy @ stage-4

claims.text: The weights are a proportion of requests, not of clients; with no session persistence configured on the route, nothing keeps one client's requests on one backend, so consecutive requests from one client may reach different weighted backends.
claims.source_hint: Gateway API docs: Traffic splitting (per-request split); session persistence is a separate, unconfigured feature; httproutes.yaml @ stage-4

claims.text: In a rolling update the share of Pods running the new version grows as old Pods are replaced, until all run it; the Service sends to every ready Pod of both versions meanwhile.
claims.source_hint: Kubernetes docs: Deployments > Rolling Update Deployment

claims.text: The edge routes (Gateway, HTTPRoute api) are in Argo CD Application edge-staging; api-canary.yaml goes into envs/staging (Application staging).

Opinion: use a small-weight canary when the new build's behaviour cannot be fully checked before real requests and both versions accept each other's data; when the new build writes data the old cannot read, make them compatible with expand and contract first.
Opinion: when one customer must see one version for every request of a visit, weights alone do not fit; blue-green, which moves every request at once, fits better.
The canary's Pod uses the same ConnectionStrings__Default Secret as api, so an order it creates is written to the same orders table.

If the config repository is not in the Kustomize layout, release_setup stops and prints the command to run first (scripts/k8s/kustomize-config-repo.sh). The cluster donhang-staging was created by OpenTofu and is synced by Argo CD.
